create_spherical_volumetric_function: create a volumetric function that renders an RGB sphere with configurable centroid and diameter
test_implicit_renderer_input_types: test the ImplicitRenderer constructor and call to raise ValueErrors on invalid raysampler, raymarcher, or volumetric function inputs
test_compare_implicit_vs_mesh_renderer: test that ImplicitRenderer output matches MeshRenderer output when rendering a sphere with randomized camera parameters
run_implicit_renderer_with_monte_carlo_r: run an ImplicitRenderer with a MonteCarloRaysampler and EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher to render a batch of spheres
test_implicit_renderer_gradient_flow: test that gradients flow correctly through ImplicitRenderer into camera variables and sphere centroid during backward pass
